Namoonni hedduun rakkoon jiru seera mataa isaa keessatti utuu hin taane, hojii irra oolmaa isaa keessatti waan ta'eef, mariin kun aangoolee giddu-galeessatti dhiphisuuf kan itti fayyadaman ta'uu danda'a jedhanii shakku.

title: Why have several nations raised red flags over Indian farm exports?
english: Several countries, including Japan, China, and members of the European Union, have recently restricted Indian agricultural exports due to concerns over quality and safety standards. Japan specifically suspended mango imports after inspectors found flaws in the sterilization and certification processes at a key facility. These trade barriers create significant economic challenges for Indian farmers, who are already struggling with climate-related crop losses and rising shipping costs.
amharic: ጃፓንን፣ ቻይናን እና የአውሮፓ ህብረት አባል ሀገራትን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሀገራት በቅርቡ በህንድ የግብርና ምርቶች ላይ የጥራት እና የደህንነት ስጋቶችን በማንሳት ገደብ ጥለዋል። በተለይም ጃፓን በማምከን እና የምስክር ወረቀት አሰጣጥ ሂደት ላይ ጉድለቶች በመገኘታቸው ከህንድ የሚገቡትን ማንጎ አግደዋል። ይህ የንግድ እገዳ በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ እና በጭነት ዋጋ መናር ምክንያት ችግር ውስጥ ላሉ የህንድ አርሶ አደሮች ትልቅ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Biyoonni hedduun, kanneen akka Jaappaan, Chaayinaa fi miseensonni gamtaa Awurooppaa, dhimma qulqullinaa fi nageenyaa irratti yaaddoo qabaachuu isaaniitiin oomishaalee qonnaa Indiyaa erguu irratti daangaa kaa’aniiru. Jaappaan keessumattuu qorannoo oomishaalee muduraa keessatti hanqina mirkaneessuu waan argiteef, ergaa maangoo Indiyaa irraa galu dhaabdeetti. Daandiin daldalaa kun qonnaan bultoota Indiyaa kanneen jijjiirama qilleensaa fi gatii geejjibaa dabaleen miidhaman irratti rakkoo dinagdee guddaa fideera.

title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine has sent proposals to US to end war with Russia
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that his government has submitted new peace proposals to the United States to help conclude the ongoing conflict with Russia. He urged Washington to boost Ukraine's air defense capabilities and exert more pressure on Moscow to discourage the continuation of hostilities. Furthermore, Zelenskyy warned that Russia intends to use upcoming parliamentary elections as a justification to launch a massive new military mobilization later this year.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘሌንስኪ ከሩሲያ ጋር ያለውን ጦርነት ለማቆም አዳዲስ የሰላም ሀሳቦችን ለአሜሪካ ማቅረባቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የዩክሬንን የአየር መከላከያ አቅም በማጠናከር በሩሲያ ላይ ተጨማሪ ግፊት እንዲያደርጉ አሜሪካን ጠይቀዋል። በተጨማሪም ዘሌንስኪ፣ ሩሲያ በቅርቡ የሚካሄደውን የፓርላማ ምርጫ ሰበብ በማድረግ አዲስ መጠነ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ቅስቀሳ ለማድረግ እያቀደች እንደሆነ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimiir Zeelenskii waraana Raashiyaa waliin jiru xumuruuf yaada furmaata haaraa gara Ameerikaatti erguu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Ameerikaan dandeettii ittisa qilleensaa Yukreen akka cimsuuf fi Raashiyaan waraana akka dhaabdu dhiibbaa akka gootu gaafataniiru. Kana malees, Zeelenskii, Raashiyaan filannoo paarlamaa dhufu fayyadamuun waraana bal'aa gara fuulduraatti gaggeessuuf qophiirra akka jirtu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Iranian attacks reportedly target several areas in Iraq's Erbil
english: Iranian military forces have launched a series of drone and missile strikes against various locations within Erbil, Iraq. The attacks reportedly hit multiple districts, including Soran, Khalifan, and Harir. Regional news outlets are currently monitoring the situation as these strikes represent a significant escalation in the area.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በኢራቅ ኤርቢል ከተማ በሚገኙ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ላይ ድሮኖችን እና ሚሳኤሎችን በመጠቀም ጥቃት አድርሰዋል። ጥቃቱ የሶራን፣ የካሊፋን እና የሀሪር ወረዳዎችን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ ቦታዎች ላይ ጉዳት ማድረሱ ተዘግቧል። በክልሉ እየተከሰተ ያለው ይህ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ከፍተኛ ውጥረትን እየፈጠረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Iraan naannoo Erbiil kan biyya Iraaq keessatti bakkeewwan garagaraatti xiyyaara malee kashaloo fi misaayilonni haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaan kun ganda Soran, Khalifan fi Harir dabalatee bakkeewwan hedduu kan rukute ta'uun gabaasameera. Gochi kun naannichatti waraanaafi tasgabbii dhabuu dhalachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Israeli attacks in south Lebanon continue, several injured
english: Military operations by Israel are persisting in southern Lebanon, where a drone strike recently injured multiple individuals. Additional heavy blasts were heard in the areas of Haddatha and Beit Yahoun. Authorities have not yet provided specific information regarding total casualties or the extent of physical destruction.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች ቀጥለዋል፣ ይህም በአንድ የድሮን ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎች እንዲቆስሉ ምክንያት ሆኗል። በተጨማሪም በሃዳታ እና በቤት ያሁን ከተሞች ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎች ተሰምተዋል። እስካሁን ድረስ ስለደረሰው ጉዳት ወይም የሟቾች ብዛት የተለየ መረጃ አልወጣም።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el kibba Libaanoositti haleellaa gaggeessaa jiru, haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin qabneen namoonni hedduun madaa'aniiru. Kana malees, magaalota Haddataa fi Beit Yahoon keessatti dhukaatin guddaan dhaga'ameera. Hanga ammaa miidhaa qaqqabe ykn namoota du'an irratti odeeffannoon sirree ta'e hin kennamne.

title: Libya power company says attack on Zawiya caused major outage
english: Libya’s national electricity provider reported a major power blackout in the southern Zawiya region following a deliberate attack on a local substation. The facility has suffered extensive damage due to frequent assaults, forcing the company to remove its repair crews for safety reasons. Consequently, officials have warned that these ongoing security threats will likely prolong the time needed to restore electricity to the affected areas.
amharic: የሊቢያ የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት ድርጅት በዛዊያ ደቡባዊ ክፍል በሚገኝ የኃይል ማከፋፈያ ጣቢያ ላይ በደረሰ ጥቃት ሰፊ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ መፈጠሩን አስታውቋል። ጣቢያው በተደጋጋሚ ጥቃት እየደረሰበት በመሆኑ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሲሆን፣ ኩባንያውም ሰራተኞቹን ከቦታው ለማስወጣት ተገዷል። በዚሁ ምክንያት የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎትን ወደነበረበት ለመመለስ የሚደረገው ጥረት ተጨማሪ መዘግየት ሊያጋጥመው እንደሚችል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni elektirikaa Liibiyaa buufata elektirikaa Zawiyaa kibbatti argamu irratti haleellaa raawwatameen haguuggiin elektirikaa bal’aan mudachuu beeksiseera. Buufatichi haleellaa irra deddeebi’ee irratti raawwatamuun miidhaan cimaan irra ga’eera; kana irraa kan ka’ees dhaabbatichi gareewwan teeknikaa isaa achii baasuuf dirqameera. Haala kanaan, haleellaawwan itti fufiinsa qaban kun tajaajila elektirikaa deebisanii dhaabuuf yeroo dheeraa akka fudhatu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Houthi attacks in Yemen's Marib, Mocha left 'dozens killed and injured', military spokesman says
english: Houthi forces launched missile and drone attacks against military installations in Marib and Mocha, Yemen. According to a Houthi spokesperson, these strikes resulted in numerous deaths and injuries, including among Saudi-affiliated personnel. The group stated that the operation was specifically directed at military targets associated with Saudi Arabia.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ማሪብ እና ሞቻ ከተሞች በሚገኙ ወታደራዊ ካምፖች ላይ የሚሳኤል እና የድሮን ጥቃት አድርሰዋል። የሁቲ ወታደራዊ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት፣ ጥቃቱ ሳዑዲ አረቢያን የሚደግፉ ኃይሎችን ኢላማ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የበርካታ ሰዎችን ህይወት መቅጠፉንና ሌሎች ላይ ጉዳት ማድረሱን ተናግረዋል። ጉዳት ከደረሰባቸው መካከል የሳዑዲ ወታደሮችም እንደሚገኙበት ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humnoonni Houthii bakkeewwan waraanaa Maariib fi Mochaa keessatti argaman irratti haleellaa misa'elaa fi dooniiwwan ofiin balali'aniin raawwataniiru. Dubbi himaan waraana Houthii akka jedhutti, haleellaan kun humnoota Sa'udii wajjin hariiroo qaban kan kaayyeeffate yoo ta'u, namoota hedduu ajjeeseera akkasumas miiidhaa irra ga'eera. Miidhaa irra ga'e keessattis lammiileen Sa'udii akka jiran ibsameera.

title: Trump says military aircraft he flew on last month faced 'greater risk'
english: Donald Trump stated that he faced significant danger while traveling on a military aircraft after leaving Turkey secretly last month. He believes this specific plane was a prime target for potential attackers due to his presence on board. Reports suggest this clandestine flight occurred in response to credible threats regarding an Iranian assassination plot.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ባለፈው ወር ከቱርክ በድብቅ በወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን ሲጓዙ ከፍተኛ አደጋ እንደገጠማቸው ተናግረዋል። በእርሳቸው መገኘት ምክንያት ያ አውሮፕላን ለጥቃት ሰለባ የመሆን ዕድሉ ከፍተኛ እንደነበር ገልጸዋል። ይህ ሚስጥራዊ ጉዞ የተደረገው ኢራን በእርሳቸው ላይ የግድያ ሙከራ ለማድረግ ማቀዷን ተከትሎ እንደሆነ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Doonaald Traamp ji'a darbe Turkey irraa xiyyaara waraanaan yeroo icitiidhaan deemanitti balaa guddaa keessa akka turan ibsaniiru. Xiyyaarichi isaanii keessa waan turaniif, qaamota biroo biratti xiyyeeffannoo guddaa akka argate fi kan qabamuuf yaalamu akka ture amanu. Adeemsi icitiidhaan gochaa turan kunis, shira ajjeechaa Iraaniin qindaa'e jedhamee sodaatame irraa kan madde akka ta'e gabaasni ni mul'isa.

title: Baby Shark Boy set to make K-pop debut
english: Park Geon-roung, who appeared as a child in the record-breaking Baby Shark music video, is now seventeen years old and preparing for a career in K-pop. He is working with Pinkfong, the entertainment company responsible for his initial viral success, to launch his music career. It remains to be seen if he can replicate his previous global popularity in the competitive Korean music industry.
amharic: በታዋቂው የቤቢ ሻርክ የሙዚቃ ቪዲዮ በልጅነቱ የታየው ፓርክ ጌኦን-ሮንግ፣ በአሁኑ ሰዓት የ17 ዓመት ወጣት ሆኗል። ወጣቱ የኬ-ፖፕ ዘፋኝ ለመሆን በመዘጋጀት ላይ ሲሆን፣ ከቀድሞው አዘጋጅ ድርጅት ከፒንክፎንግ ጋር በመተባበር የሙዚቃ ጉዞውን እየጀመረ ነው። በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በነበረው ዝና የሙዚቃ ስራው ምን ያህል ተቀባይነት እንደሚያገኝ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Park Geon-roung kan fiilmii muuziqaa 'Baby Shark' kan baay'ee beekame irratti ijoollummaa isaa hirmaate, amma waggaa 17 ta'eera. Innis guddina muuziqaa 'K-pop' keessatti hirmaachuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Dhaabbata 'Pinkfong' jedhamu waliin ta'uun hojjechaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, muuziqaan isaa milkaa'ina inni kanaan dura argate argachuu danda'a moo hin danda'u kan jedhu kan ilaallamu ta'a.

title: Can Trump keep his ‘irritation’ with Netanyahu in check?
english: Tensions are rising between Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu due to their conflicting views on Gaza peace plans. It remains uncertain whether this dispute is a minor policy disagreement or a more serious fracture in their political relationship. Observers are questioning if Trump can maintain composure regarding these differences as their strategic alignment faces new challenges.
amharic: በዶናልድ ትራምፕ እና በእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ መካከል በጋዛ የሰላም ዕቅድ ላይ ባላቸው ልዩነት ሳቢያ አለመግባባት እየተፈጠረ ነው። ይህ መካረር በፖሊሲ ላይ የተመሠረተ ጊዜያዊ አለመግባባት ወይስ በሁለቱ መሪዎች መካከል የተፈጠረ ጥልቅ የፖለቲካ ልዩነት መሆኑ እስካሁን ግልጽ አይደለም። ትራምፕ በጉዳዩ ላይ ያላቸውን ብስጭት መቆጣጠር ይችሉ እንደሆነ እና የሁለቱ መሪዎች ግንኙነት ወደፊት ምን እንደሚመስል ብዙዎች እየተጠራጠሩ ነው።
oromo: Donald Trumpifi ministirri muummee Israa'el Benjamin Netanyahu karoora nagaa Gaazaarratti yaada garaa garuun qabaachuun isaanii wal-dhabdee keessa akka galan taasiseera. Wal-dhabdeen kun rakkoo siyaasaa gadi fagoo ta'e ykn yaada marii irratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu isaa adda baasuun ammayyuu rakkisaadha. Trump garaa garummaa kana irratti obsa qabaachuu danda'uufi dhiisuu isaanii akkasumas hariiroon isaanii gara fuulduraatti maal akka fakkaatu irratti gaaffiin hedduun ka'aa jira.

title: Israeli raids, demolitions continue as UN warns West Bank at breaking point
english: Israeli forces have intensified their military operations in the occupied West Bank, conducting multiple arrests and destroying numerous Palestinian homes and facilities. The United Nations has raised concerns that the situation in the territory has reached a critical breaking point due to these ongoing actions and increasing settler violence. Authorities continue to implement controversial demolition policies against the families of Palestinians involved in conflicts, leaving many residents displaced.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ወታደራዊ ዘመቻውን በማጠናከር በበርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ እስር የፈጸመ ሲሆን የፍልስጤማውያንን መኖሪያ ቤቶችና ንብረቶች አፍርሷል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት አካባቢው ከፍተኛ ቀውስ ውስጥ እንደገባ በማስጠንቀቅ በግጭቱ እና በሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ምክንያት ሁኔታው ሊፈነዳ እንደሚችል ገልጿል። እስራኤል ከጥቃት ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው በሚል የፍልስጤማውያን ቤቶችን የማፍረስ ፖሊሲዋን በመቀጠሏ ብዙ ቤተሰቦች ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አድርጋለች።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'eel naannoo West Bank keessatti tarkaanfii waraanaa jabeessuun, namoota hedduu hidhaa fi manneen jireenyaa fi qabeenya Falasxinootaa mancaasuu itti fufaniiru. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii haalli naannichaa sadarkaa hamaa irra gahuu isaa fi miidhaan manneen jireenyaa akkasumas haleellaan warra biyya isaanii irraa buqqa'anii dhufanii (settlers) haala jiru daran hammaachisuu isaa ibseera. Israa'eel qondaaltoota Falasxiin waliin walitti bu'iinsa uumanii turan jedhamanii kan shakakamanii maatiiwwan isaanii irratti manneen diiguu itti fuftee waan jirtuuf, namoonni hedduu buqqa'uun isaanii gabaasameera.

title: Did Trump flee an Iranian assassination plot on a catering truck?
english: Reports suggest that former President Donald Trump was moved into a catering truck to secretly switch aircraft while departing a NATO summit in Ankara. This precaution was allegedly taken due to concerns regarding a potential bomb plot against him. Trump has stated that the decision to change planes was handled by the Secret Service.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአንካራ የኔቶ ስብሰባ ሲመለሱ በቦምብ ጥቃት ሊፈጸምባቸው ይችላል በሚል ስጋት፣ ከሌላ አውሮፕላን ወደ ሌላ ለመቀየር በምግብ ማመላለሻ መኪና ውስጥ ተደብቀው እንደነበር ተነግሯል። ትራምፕ በበኩላቸው የአውሮፕላን መቀየር ውሳኔው ሙሉ በሙሉ በሚስጥር አገልግሎት ሰጪዎች (Secret Service) የተወሰደ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidantiin duraanii Doonaald Tiraamp gubaa'ii NeeToo (NATO) Ankaaraatti godhame booda yeroo deebi'an, karoora boombii irratti xiyyeeffate tokkoon walqabatee xiyyaara jijjiiruuf konkolaataa nyaata fe'u keessa dhokachuun isaanii gabaafameera. Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, xiyyaara jijjiiruun kun murtoo 'Siikreet Sarviisii' (Secret Service) tiin raawwatame dha.

title: Trump says secret plane switch ‘up to the Secret Service’
english: Donald Trump stated that the Secret Service was responsible for a discreet change of aircraft following a NATO summit in Turkey. Reports indicate that he had to board a different plane using a catering vehicle to avoid potential risks. This move allegedly occurred due to concerns regarding a possible Iranian assassination plot.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቱርክ የኔቶ ጉባኤ ከተጠናቀቀ በኋላ የአውሮፕላን ለውጥ ያደረጉት በምስጢራዊ አገልግሎት (Secret Service) ትእዛዝ መሆኑን ገለጹ። እንደ ዘገባዎቹ ከሆነ፣ ኢራን አነጣጠረችብኝ በሚል ስጋት ምክንያት፣ የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት በምግብ ማቅረቢያ መኪና ተጠቅመው ወደ ሌላ አውሮፕላን እንዲሸጋገሩ ተደርጓል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ሊደርስባቸው ይችላል የተባለውን የደህንነት ስጋት ለመከላከል ነው።
oromo: Donald Trump erga gubaa'ii NATO kan Turkey irratti xumuramee booda, jijjiirraa xiyyaaraa kan godhe ajaja Secret Service tiin ta'uu ibse. Gabaasni akka agarsiisutti, sodaannoo hidhata Iran irraa dhufuun, Trump xiyyaara biraa gahuuf konkolaataa nyaata fe'uun fayyadamuu isaa ibsameera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame sodaa yakka ajjeechaa kan irra jiru ta'uu isaa hordofee dha.

title: Drone strikes power station near Libya’s largest oil refinery
english: A drone recently hit a power plant located in the city of Zawiya, Libya. This facility is situated close to the nation’s primary active oil refinery. Because the refinery has faced repeated attacks lately, authorities are now thinking about closing it down.
amharic: አንድ ድሮን በሊቢያ ዛዊያ ከተማ በሚገኝ የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ ጣቢያ ላይ ጥቃት አድርሷል። ይህ ጣቢያ የአገሪቱ ትልቁ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ አጠገብ የሚገኝ ነው። ማጣሪያው በቅርብ ቀናት ውስጥ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች ስላጋጠሙት መንግስት ስራውን ለማቆም እያሰበ ነው።
oromo: Xiyyaaraan malee ooftuu (drone) magaala Liibiyaa Zaawiyaatti argamu buufata anniisaa ibsaa tokko irratti haleellaa raawwate. Buufanni kun bakka warshaan baasii boba'aa guddaan biyyattii itti argamu sanatti dhihoo dha. Warshichi guyyoota darban keessa haleellaa deddeebi'amee irra gahaa waan jiruuf, mootummaan hojii warshicha dhaabuu irratti mari'achaa jira.

title: Trump says he switched planes after Nato summit because of possible threat
english: Former President Donald Trump confirmed that he secretly switched planes after a NATO summit in Turkey due to a potential security threat. U.S. officials reportedly received intelligence regarding a credible risk of an Iranian missile attack on the president's aircraft. To ensure his safety, the Secret Service utilized a decoy plane and moved Trump to a military jet using a catering truck, keeping the maneuver hidden from most staff and journalists on board.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቱርክ በተካሄደው የኔቶ ጉባኤ ማጠናቀቂያ ላይ ሊደርስባቸው የነበረውን ስጋት በመፍራት በድብቅ አውሮፕላን መቀየራቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት በፕሬዝዳንቱ አውሮፕላን ላይ ሊቃጣ የሚችል የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ስጋት መኖሩን በመጠራጠራቸው ይህ እርምጃ መወሰዱ ተገልጿል። ለደህንነታቸው ሲባል የአሜሪካ የደህንነት ተቋም አባላት ፕሬዝዳንቱን በምግብ ማመላለሻ መኪና በመጠቀም ወደ ሌላ ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን በማዘዋወር ከጋዜጠኞች እና ከሰራተኞች በተሰወረ መንገድ እንዲጓዙ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin duraanii Doonaald Tiraamp, walga'ii Naatoo erga xumuranii booda doorsisa nageenyaa mudachuu danda'u tokkoon kan ka'e, xiyyaara isaan ittiin imalan dhoksaadhaan jijjiiruu isaanii mirkaneessaniiru. Qondaalonni Ameerikaa, xiyyaara pireezidaantichaa irratti weerarri mishaayilii Iran irraa dhufuu danda'u jiraachuu isaa odeeffannoo argachuu isaanii gabaasni ni mul'isa. Nageenya isaanii eeguuf, gareen ittisaa isaa xiyyaara sobaa tokko fayyadamanii fi konkolaataa nyaata fe'uun Pireezidaanticha xiyyaara waraanaa biraatti jijjiiruudhaan, hojjettootaa fi gaazexeessitoota irraa dhoksuun bakka biraatti akka geessaman godhaniiru.

title: New Zealand PM survives second leadership challenge ahead of election
english: New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon successfully maintained his position after winning a confidence vote called to address internal doubts about his leadership. His administration has faced growing pressure due to a weak economy, rising unemployment, and a series of controversial public remarks. Despite these setbacks and declining poll numbers, Luxon insists his party remains unified and committed to succeeding in the upcoming November election.
amharic: የኒውዚላንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ክሪስቶፈር ሉክሰን ስለ አመራር ብቃታቸው የተነሳውን ጥርጣሬ ተከትሎ በተደረገው የምክር ቤት እምነት የማግኘት ድምጽ አሸንፈው በስልጣን ላይ መቆየት ችለዋል። መንግስታቸው በኢኮኖሚ ድክመት፣ በስራ አጥነት መጨመር እና በአንዳንድ አወዛጋቢ ንግግሮቻቸው ሳቢያ ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ወድቋል። እነዚህ ችግሮች እና የህዝብ ድጋፍ መቀነስ ቢኖርም፣ ሉክሰን ፓርቲያቸው በአንድነት የቆመ እና በህዳር ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ለማሸነፍ ቁርጠኛ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Niwuu Ziilaand Kiristoofar Luksaniin, shakkii gaggeessummaa isaa irratti ka'e hordofee sagalee amantii itti kenname injifachuun bakka isaa eeggachuu danda'eera. Guddinni dinagdee hir'achuu, hojii dhabdummaan dabaluu fi yaada inni hawaasa irratti dubbateen walqabatee mormiin guddaan mootummaa isaa irratti ka'aa ture. Rakkoolee fi fudhatamni isaa gadi bu'uu isaatiin ala, Luksaniin paartiin isaa tokkummaan akka jiru fi filannoo ji'a Sadaasaa dhufu keessatti injifachuuf murteeffatanii akka ka'an ibseera.

title: Dozens dead and missing after ferry capsizes in Zimbabwe
english: An overloaded ferry sank in Zimbabwe’s Lake Kariba, resulting in at least 15 deaths and 27 people still unaccounted for. Rescue teams managed to save 77 passengers who were transported to a nearby island. Search efforts remain ongoing to locate the missing individuals.
amharic: በዚምባብዌ ካሪባ ሐይቅ ላይ ከመጠን በላይ ተሳፋሪዎችን የጫነ ጀልባ በመስጠሙ ቢያንስ 15 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል፣ 27 ሰዎች ደግሞ የት እንደደረሱ አይታወቅም። የነፍስ አድን ሠራተኞች 77 ተሳፋሪዎችን ማዳን የቻሉ ሲሆን የተረፉትም በአቅራቢያው ወደሚገኝ ደሴት ተወስደዋል። የጠፉ ሰዎችን የመፈለግ ሥራው አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Ziimbaabwee keessatti markabni namoota baay'ee fe'atee ture haroowwan Kaaribaa keessatti gombifamuun, namoonni 15 ol du'aniiru, 27 immoo bakka buutee isaanii hin beekamu. Gareen gargaarsa namootaa namoota 77 oolchuun gara daa'imman sanaatti erganii jiru. Hojii namoota bade barbaaduus ammaaf itti fufaa jira.

title: Iran holds firm on Hormuz conditions as Pakistan’s Naqvi visits Tehran
english: Iran's top security official, Mohsen Rezaei, has declared that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the United States ends its military campaigns and blockades, releases frozen assets, and supports a regional ceasefire. These firm conditions were reiterated during a visit by Pakistan's interior minister to Tehran as diplomatic efforts to resolve the ongoing conflict continue. Meanwhile, President Trump has indicated uncertainty about the path forward, alternating between the possibility of a deal and threats of further pressure on Iran.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ባለስልጣን ሞህሰን ረዛኢ የሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ እንደገና ከመከፈቱ በፊት አሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻዋን እና ማዕቀቦቿን ማቆም፣ የታገዱ የኢራን ንብረቶችን መልቀቅ እና በጋዛና በሊባኖስ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነትን መደገፍ እንዳለባት አስታውቀዋል። ይህ አቋም የፓኪስታን የውስጥ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር በቴህራን ጉብኝት ባደረጉበት ወቅት የተገለጸ ሲሆን የዲፕሎማሲያዊ የሽምግልና ጥረቶችም ቀጥለዋል። በሌላ በኩል ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የኢራንን ኢኮኖሚ በማዳከም ወይም ተጨማሪ ጫና በመፍጠር መካከል እንደሚዋዥቁ ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni nageenyaa Iraan, Mohsen Rezaei, hanga Ameerikaan duula waraanaa fi daangaa sana irratti qabdu dhaabdu, qabeenya Iraan qabame gadi dhiistu, akkasumas ce'umsa waraanaa guutuu biyya lafaa fi naannichaa (Gaza fi Libaanoos) kabajjuutti, daandiin Hormuz akka hin banamne dubbataniiru. Haala cimaa kana kan ibsan yoo ta'u, ergamtootni Paakistaan karaa dippiloomaasiin rakkoo kana furuuf gara Teheran imaluun marii taasisaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Prezidaant Traamp Iraan irratti dhiibbaa diinagdee gochuun ykn tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuun gidduutti murtoo irratti wal dhabaa jiraachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Stronghold of Syrian revolution celebrates Assad’s death sentence
english: Residents of Idlib, a key center for the Syrian opposition, recently held public celebrations following a court ruling. The judicial decision handed down death sentences to former leader Bashar al-Assad and other officials for atrocities committed during the nation's civil war. This development marks a significant symbolic moment for the region that led the uprising against the Assad family's five-decade rule.
amharic: የሶሪያ ተቃዋሚዎች ማዕከል በሆነችው ኢድሊብ ከተማ ነዋሪዎች የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት በሽር አል-አሳድ የሞት ፍርድ እንደተፈረደባቸው ሲሰሙ ደስታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ አሳድን እና ሌሎች የቀድሞ ባለስልጣናትን ለስልጣን ዘመናቸው በሶሪያ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ወቅት ለፈጸሙት ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ብሏቸዋል። ይህ ክስተት የአሳድን ቤተሰብ የአምስት አስርት ዓመታት የግዛት ዘመን ላስቆመው እንቅስቃሴ ትልቅ ትርጉም ያለው ድል ተደርጎ ታይቷል።
oromo: Buufata mormitoota Siiriyaa kan taate Idliib keessatti, jiraattonni pirezidaantii duraanii Bashaar al-Asaad irratti murtiin du'aa darbuu isaa erga dhaga'anii booda gammachuu isaanii ibsataniiru. Mana maree murtichaa kanneen yeroo waraana Siiriyaa keessatti yakka raawwataniif itti gaafatamtoota turan irratti adabbii cimaa kana murteesse. Murtiin kun maatii Asaad waggoota shantamii sadiif biyyattii bulchaa turan irratti kan xumura godhe ta'uun isaa iddoo kanaaf hiika guddaa qaba.

title: On the ground in Cali, Colombia’s worst-hit city after the quake
english: Following a powerful earthquake, the city of Cali, Colombia, is facing a severe crisis as the death toll continues to rise. Local residents and volunteers are working tirelessly to search through the ruins of collapsed buildings for survivors. The situation remains critical as rescue efforts persist in the hardest-hit areas of the country's third-largest city.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ ከተማ ካሊ የተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ የብዙ ሰዎችን ሕይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን የሟቾች ቁጥርም እየጨመረ ይገኛል። በከተማዋ ፍርስራሾች ውስጥ የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ በጎ ፈቃደኞች ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። በኮሎምቢያ ሦስተኛዋ ትልቅ ከተማ የሆነችው ካሊ፣ በአደጋው ክፉኛ በመጎዳቷ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች በአስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa magaalaa Kaalii keessatti sochiin lafaa cimaan erga mudatee booda, lakkoofsi namoota du'anii dabalaa jira. Magaalattii keessatti, namoonni fedhiin hojjetan diigamuu manneenii keessatti lubbuun namoota hafan barbaaduuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Magaalaa sadooffaa Kolombiyaa taate kana keessatti haalli jiru baay'ee yaaddessaa dha.

title: Zambia to vote as economic hardship tests government reforms
english: Zambians are heading to the polls to vote in a general election that serves as a referendum on the government’s economic performance. While officials highlight successes like debt restructuring and international policy reforms, many citizens remain frustrated by the high cost of food, fuel, and electricity. Voters will ultimately decide if these macroeconomic improvements have positively impacted their daily lives and household financial stability.
amharic: የዛምቢያ ህዝብ በመንግስት የኢኮኖሚ አፈጻጸም ላይ ወሳኝ ውሳኔ ለመስጠት ወደ ምርጫ ጣቢያዎች እያመሩ ነው። መንግስት የዕዳ ማሻሻያ እና የኢኮኖሚ ለውጦችን እንደ ስኬት ቢቆጥርም፣ በሌላ በኩል የኑሮ ውድነት እና የምግብ፣ የነዳጅ እንዲሁም የኤሌክትሪክ ዋጋ መናር በዜጎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ተፅእኖ ፈጥሯል። በመሆኑም መራጮች እነዚህ የመንግስት የኢኮኖሚ ለውጦች በተግባር የዕለት ተዕለት ኑሯቸውን እንዳሻሻሉ በመመዘን ድምፃቸውን ይሰጣሉ።
oromo: Uummanni Zaambiyaa hojiilee diinagdee mootummaan hojjete irratti murtoo kennuuf gara sagalee kennuutti deemaa jiru. Mootummaan jijjiirama diinagdee fi hir’ina liqii akka milkaa’inaatti kan dhiyeessu ta’us, lammiileen baay’een gatii midhaan nyaataa, boba’aa fi elektirikii dabaluun jireenya irratti dhiibbaa uumuutti gungumachaa jiru. Kanaafuu, filattoonni jijjiiramonni diinagdee kunniin jireenya isaanii guyyuu keessatti jijjiirama dhugaa fiduu isaanii ilaaluun murtoo isaanii dabarsu.

title: Pentagon admits to killing 153 civilians last year in Yemen: Report
english: The Pentagon has officially informed Congress that American military operations against Houthi forces in Yemen last year resulted in the deaths of 153 civilians and left 243 others injured. The report highlights several specific deadly strikes that occurred during April, including a major incident at Ras Isa port. Officials also noted that investigations are still ongoing regarding at least 15 additional cases involving civilian casualties.
amharic: የፔንታጎን ባለስልጣናት ባለፈው አመት በየመን በሁቲዎች ላይ ባደረጉት ወታደራዊ ጥቃት 153 ንፁሃን ዜጎች መገደላቸውን እና 243 ሰዎች መቁሰላቸውን ለኮንግረስ አረጋግጠዋል። በሪፖርቱ መሰረት፣ በኤፕሪል ወር ብቻ በሶስት ዋና ዋና ጥቃቶች ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት ጠፍቷል፤ ከእነዚህም መካከል በራስ ኢሳ ወደብ ላይ የተፈጸመው ጥቃት ይገኝበታል። በተጨማሪም፣ ፔንታጎን ከዚህ ጋር በተያያዘ ሌሎች 15 ጉዳዮች አሁንም እየተጣሩ መሆናቸውን ገልጿል።
oromo: Pentagoniin gabaasa mana maree biyyattii qaqqabsiiseen, bara darbe Yemen keessatti loltoota Huthitti tarkaanfii fudhateen namoonni nagaa 153 du’anii 243 immoo madaa’uu isaanii mirkaneesseera. Gabaasichi akka ibsutti, miidhaan guddaan kun ji’a Ebla keessa kan qaqqabe yoo ta’u, keessattuu rukuttaa buufata doonii Raas Isaa irratti raawwatameen lubbuun namoota baay’ee darbeera. Kana malees, qorannoon dhimmoota biraa 15 irratti ammas itti fufaa akka jiru Pentagoniin beeksiseera.

title: US in ‘total control’ of Strait of Hormuz, Trump says
english: Former President Donald Trump recently asserted that the United States maintains complete authority over the Strait of Hormuz. He expressed a deep lack of trust in Iran while describing the ongoing diplomatic situation with Tehran as stable. According to him, American naval strength ensures that the U.S. remains the sole power in control of this critical maritime route.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ፣ አሜሪካ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ሰርጥ ላይ ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንዳላት ተናግረዋል። ከኢራን ጋር ስላለው ግንኙነት ሲገልጹ፣ በቴህራን ላይ እምነት እንደሌላቸው ገልጸው አሁን ያለው ሁኔታ የተረጋጋ መሆኑን ጠቁመዋል። አሜሪካ ባላት የባህር ኃይል አቅም፣ ይህንን ወሳኝ የውሃ መስመር ሙሉ በሙሉ መቆጣጠሯን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Amerikaa duraanii Donald Traamp, Amerikaan balbala galaana Hormuz irratti guutummaatti to'annoo akka qabdu ibsan. Isaan haala ammayyaa kana ilaalchisee garaa garummaa yaadaa qabanis, walitti dhufeenyi Iran waliin jiru tasgabbaa'aa akka jiru dubbataniiru. Humni galaana Amerikaa cimaa waan ta'eef, karaa daandii galaana kanaa to'achuun isaan qofa akka ta'e mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Qatar condemns Colombia’s backing of Israeli claims over occupied Golan Heights
english: Qatar has officially criticized Colombia for acknowledging Israel's sovereignty over the Golan Heights. The Qatari government maintains that this area is occupied Arab territory and argues that such recognition violates international law. Officials in Doha warned that supporting Israel's claim creates a significant barrier to establishing long-term peace in the region.
amharic: ኳታር ኮሎምቢያ የጎላን ኮረብታዎች የእስራኤል ግዛት ናቸው ብላ በመቀበሏ ተቃውሞዋን በይፋ ገልጻለች። የኳታር መንግስት ይህ ቦታ የተያዘ የአረብ ግዛት እንደሆነ አቋሙን የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ እንዲህ አይነት እውቅና መስጠት የአለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥስ እንደሆነ አስታውቋል። በዶሃ የሚገኙ ባለስልጣናት የእስራኤልን የይገባኛል ጥያቄ መደገፍ ለክልሉ ዘላቂ ሰላም ትልቅ እንቅፋት እንደሚሆን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Qatar mootummaan Kolombiyaa daangaa Golan kan Israa'eliin bulfamu ta'uu isaa beekamtii kennuun isaa akka isaan morman ibsiteetti. Mootummaan Qatar lafti kun kan biyyoota Arabaa akka ta'e fi beekamtii akkasii kennuun seera idil-addunyaa faallessu akka ta'e dubbatti. Itti gaafatamtoonni Doohaa deeggarsa akkasii kennuun nagaa naannichaa buusuuf gufuu guddaa ta'a jechuun akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Trump's dramatic plane swap hints at personal stakes of Iran war
english: President Trump recently used a decoy plane and a catering truck to secretly switch aircraft following intelligence reports of an Iranian missile threat against Air Force One. This move highlights the intense and personal nature of the conflict between Trump and Iran, which has included previous assassination plots and US-led military strikes. While security experts note that such precautions are sometimes necessary in war zones, the unusual method of his travel underscores ongoing fears for the president’s safety.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በቅርቡ በአየር ኃይል አንድ አውሮፕላን ላይ ሊሰነዘር የሚችል የኢራን ሚሳኤል ጥቃት ስጋት መኖሩን ተከትሎ፣ አውሮፕላናቸውን በድብቅ ቀይረዋል። የፕሬዝዳንቱ የደህንነት ቡድን ለጉዞው የማታለያ ዘዴዎችን በመጠቀም ትራምፕን በምግብ ማመላለሻ መኪና ውስጥ በመደበቅ ከአንድ አውሮፕላን ወደ ሌላ እንዲዛወሩ አድርገዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በፕሬዝዳንቱ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት ምን ያህል የግል እና አደገኛ እንደሆነ የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ የደህንነት ስጋቱም ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ ያመላክታል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp yeroo dhihoo kana xiyyaarri 'Air Force One' haleellaa misaa'elaa Iraan irraa itti yaadamee jiraachuu ibsuun, xiyyaara isaa icitiidhaan jijjiirrateera. Gareen nageenyaa isaanii mala ispoortii fayyadamuun, pireezidaanticha konkolaataa nyaata fe'u keessatti dhoksudhaan xiyyaara gara biraatti akka jijjiirran godhaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun walitti bu'iinsa pireezidaantichaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru akkam akka dhuunfaa fi sodaachisaa ta'e kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, yaaddoon nageenyaa irratti qabanis hangam akka olaanaa ta'e mul'isa.

title: N Korea launches ballistic missile as S Korea, US plan military drills
english: North Korea fired a ballistic missile toward the Sea of Japan, marking its second weapons test in less than a week. This launch coincides with preparations by South Korea and the United States for their upcoming joint military exercises scheduled to begin on August 17. Analysts view these actions as a typical response from Pyongyang to signal its opposition to the planned defense drills.
amharic: ሰሜን ኮሪያ በሳምንት ውስጥ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤል ወደ ጃፓን ባህር አስወንጭፋለች። ይህ ድርጊት የተፈፀመው ደቡብ ኮሪያ እና አሜሪካ ኦገስት 17 ሊጀምሩት ላቀዱት የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ ዝግጅት እያደረጉ ባለበት ወቅት ነው። የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች ይህንን የሰሜን ኮሪያ እርምጃ የታቀደውን ወታደራዊ ልምምድ በመቃወም የምታሳየው ምላሽ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Koreen Kaabaa torban tokko hin guunne keessatti yeroo lammaffaaf xiyyara gosa balistikii gara galaana Jaappaaniitti gadi lakkifteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame yeroo Koriyaan Kibbaa fi Ameerikaan leenjii waraanaa gamtaa waggaa isaanii Hagayya 17 eegaluuf qophaa'aa jiranitti. Qorattoonni akka ibsanitti, gochi kun mormii Pyoongyaang leenjii waraanaa isaanirratti qabdu ibsuuf kan taasifame dha.

title: Iran war live: US fires missiles at cargo ship violating Iran blockade
english: The United States military used Hellfire missiles to disable a Panamanian cargo ship that refused to stop while heading toward an Iranian port. Tensions remain high as Iran insists it will keep the Strait of Hormuz closed until the US ends its military actions, lifts its blockade, and releases frozen assets. Meanwhile, diplomatic efforts involving Qatar and Oman are currently underway to negotiate the future of shipping routes in the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ወደ ኢራን ወደብ ሲጓዝ የነበረ እና ማስጠንቀቂያውን ችላ ያለ የፓናማ የጭነት መርከብን በሁለት ሚሳኤሎች መትተው አቁመዋል። ኢራን የአሜሪካን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እስካልቆመ ድረስ እና የታገዱ ንብረቶቿ እስካልተለቀቁ ድረስ የሆርሙዝ ወሽመጥ እንደተዘጋ እንደሚቆይ አስታውቃለች። በአሁኑ ወቅት የኳታር እና የኦማን አደላዳይነት የባህር ማጓጓዣ መስመሩን ለመክፈት ድርድሮች እየተካሄዱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa doonii fe'umsaa kan Panamaan galchoofte, gara buufata doonii Iraanitti imalaa yeroo turte fi akeekkachiisa didde, maseelii lamaan rukutuun dhaabsiseera. Iraan hanga Ameerikaan tarkaanfii waraanaa dhaabdu, uggura kaastu fi qabeenya ishee qabame gadhiiftutti, bakki dhangala'aa Hormuz cufaa akka ta'u ibsiteetti. Yeroo ammaa kanatti, Qatar fi Omaan giddu galeessummaa ta'uun dhimma daandii galaanaarratti mariin gaggeeffamaa jira.

title: Cargo ship in flames after Houthi attack in Bab al-Mandeb strait
english: An Egyptian-owned cargo ship caught fire after being struck in the Bab al-Mandeb strait by suspected Houthi rebels. The attack reportedly resulted in the deaths of four crew members. If verified, these would be the first fatalities caused by Houthi strikes on commercial vessels since the current regional conflict began.
amharic: በባቢ አል-ማንደብ የባህር ወሽመጥ የግብፅ የጭነት መርከብ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃት ደርሶባት በእሳት ተያያዘች። ጥቃቱ በአራት የመርከቧ ሠራተኞች ሕይወት ማለፍ ምክንያት ሆኗል ተብሏል። ይህ መረጃ ከተረጋገጠ፣ ግጭቱ ከተጀመረ ወዲህ በንግድ መርከቦች ላይ በሁቲዎች ከተሰነዘረ ጥቃት የደረሰ የመጀመሪያው የሰው ሕይወት መጥፋት ይሆናል።
oromo: Markaan fe'umsaa kan Gibxi tokko, daandii galaana Bab al-Mandeb keessatti haleellaa garee Huutii jedhamuun erga rukutamee booda ibiddaan gubateera. Haleellaa kanaanis hojjettoonni markittii afur du'uu gabaasameera. Oduun kun yoo mirkanaa'e, waldhabdee yeroo ammaa kana keessatti duuti yeroo jalqabaaf haleellaa Huutiin markaboota daldalaa irra ga'e ta'a.

title: Israel and Venezuela restore diplomatic relations after years of severed ties
english: Israel and Venezuela have officially resumed diplomatic relations after a 17-year break. This change follows a shift in Venezuela's leadership under acting President Delcy Rodriguez, who has moved the country closer to the United States. Both nations have now established a system to provide essential consular services to their citizens.
amharic: እስራኤል እና ቬንዙዌላ ለ17 ዓመታት ተቋርጦ የነበረውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነታቸውን በይፋ እንደገና ጀምረዋል። ይህ ለውጥ የመጣው በጊዜያዊቷ ፕሬዝዳንት ደልሲ ሮድሪጌዝ ስር ቬንዙዌላ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያላትን ግንኙነት ማጠናከሯን ተከትሎ ነው። አገራቱ ለዜጎቻቸው አስፈላጊ የቆንስላ አገልግሎቶችን ለመስጠት የሚያስችል համባበር መፍጠራቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Israa'el fi Veenzuweelaan waggaa 17 booda hariiroo diippiloomaasii isaanii irra deebiin diriirsuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Jijjiiramni kun kan dhufe pirezidaantii yeroo kan ta'an Delcii Rodriigeez jalatti Veenzuweelaan gara Ameerikaatti dhihaachuu ishee hordofeeti. Biyyoonni lamaanuu amma lammiilee isaaniif tajaajila koonsilaa barbaachisaa ta'e kennuuf waliigaltee irra ga'aniiru.

title: Israeli forces attack agricultural land in Syria, set up military checkpoint
english: On Tuesday, Israeli military forces launched three shells at farmland near the village of Hamidiya in the Quneitra region of Syria. Additionally, troops established a temporary military checkpoint in the nearby town of Kudna. These actions mark a continuation of Israeli military activity within Syrian territory.
amharic: ባለፈው ማክሰኞ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በሶሪያ ኩኒትራ ግዛት በሚገኝ የግብርና መሬት ላይ ሶስት ጥይቶችን ተኩሰዋል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም ወታደሮቹ በኩድና አካባቢ ጊዜያዊ ወታደራዊ መቆጣጠሪያ ጣቢያ አቋቁመዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በእስራኤል በኩል በሶሪያ ግዛት ውስጥ የሚደረገውን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Guyyaa Kibxata darbe, waraanni Israa'el naannoo Quneitra kan Suuriyaatti argamu qonnaa Hamidiyaatti dhukaasa meeshaa waraanaa sadii geggeessaniiru. Kana malees, waraanni kun magaalaa Kudna jedhamtu keessatti bakka to'annoo waraanaa yeroo dhaabaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun qindoomina waraanni Israa'el biyya Suuriyaa keessatti taasisaa jiru kan mul'isudha.

title: These seaside apartments were a ghost city - then police say scammers moved in
english: Malaysia's Forest City, a massive $100 billion project meant to house 700,000 people, has largely failed and remains nearly vacant. Taking advantage of the empty space, criminal groups recently turned dozens of these apartments into hubs for international cryptocurrency and romance scams. Authorities have since raided these locations, arresting over 300 individuals and seizing a significant amount of digital equipment used for illegal activities.
amharic: የማሌዢያዋ 'ፎረስት ሲቲ' የተባለችው ግዙፍ የ100 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ፕሮጀክት፣ 700 ሺህ ነዋሪዎችን ለማስተናገድ ታቅዶ የነበረ ቢሆንም በአሁኑ ወቅት ባዶ ቀርታለች። ይህንን ባዶነት በመጠቀም ወንጀለኞች በርካታ አፓርትመንቶችን በመቆጣጠር ዓለም አቀፍ የዲጂታል ገንዘብ እና የፍቅር ግንኙነት ማጭበርበሪያ ማዕከላት አድርገዋቸው ነበር። የሀገሪቱ ፖሊስ ባደረገው ኦፕሬሽን ከ300 በላይ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋለ ሲሆን ለማጭበርበሪያነት ያገለግሉ የነበሩ በርካታ የኤሌክትሮኒክስ መሣሪያዎችንም ተቆጣጥሯል።
oromo: Magaalaan 'Forest City' jedhamtu kan Maaleezhiyaatti argamtu fi namoota 700,000 qabachuu qabduu, hojiin ishee waan hin milkoofneef amma gaddaafi duwwaa taateetti. Gareewwan yakka raawwatan, magaalattiin nama hin qabne kana fayyadamuun, gamoowwan ishee keessatti bakka maallaqa dijitaalaa fi hariiroo jaalalaa sobaan itti raawwatan bananii turan. Poolisiin biyyattii tarkaanfii fudhateen namoota 300 ol to'annoo jala oolche akkasumas meeshaalee elektirooniksii yakka sanaaf itti fayyadamaa turan hedduu harka isaanii galfataniiru.

title: Colombia scrambles to find survivors after deadly earthquake
english: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia, causing widespread destruction and the deaths of at least 254 people. Rescue crews and volunteers are currently working around the clock to find survivors trapped under collapsed buildings in cities like Cali and Pereira. Thousands of homes have been damaged, and there is urgent concern for many individuals, including children, who remain missing in the debris.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ የተከሰተ ኃይለኛ 7.4 መጠን ያለው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 254 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች እና በጎ ፈቃደኞች በካሊ እና በፔሬራ ከተሞች የፈራረሱ ሕንፃዎችን በማፈራረስ የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለማግኘት ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶች በመውደማቸው እና ብዙ ሰዎች፣ ህፃናትን ጨምሮ፣ ፍርስራሽ ውስጥ ተጠምደው በመሆናቸው የነፍስ አድን ስራው ተጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa lixaatti lafti socho’uun hanga 7.4 gahuun lubbuun namoota 254 ol akka darbu taasiseera. Ogeeyyonni gargaarsaa fi namoonni fedhiin hojjatan magaalaawwan akka Cali fi Pereira keessatti manneen diigaman keessa warra lubbuun jiran barbaaduuf guyyaa fi halkan hojjachaa jiru. Manneen kumaan lakkaawwaman diigamuun isaa fi ijoollee dabalatee namoonni hedduun caccabaa manaa jala hafuun isaanii gargaarsicha ariifachiisaa taasiseera.

title: Turkey condems Colombia's support for Israeli Golan Heights occupation
english: Turkey has officially criticized Colombia for acknowledging Israeli control over the Golan Heights, a region that is internationally recognized as part of Syria. This decision follows similar backlash from several other nations, including Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Iraq. The Turkish government emphasized that this move undermines Syrian sovereignty and has urged the international community to work toward ending the occupation.
amharic: ቱርክ ኮሎምቢያ በጎላን ኮረብታ ላይ የእስራኤልን የበላይነት እውቅና መስጠቷን በይፋ አውግዛለች፤ ይህ አካባቢ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የሶሪያ ግዛት እንደሆነ ይታወቃል። ይህ የቱርክ ውሳኔ እንደ ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ኳታር እና ኢራቅ ካሉ ሌሎች ሀገራት ከተሰነዘረ ተመሳሳይ ተቃውሞ ጋር ተያይዞ የመጣ ነው። የቱርክ መንግስት ይህ ድርጊት የሶሪያን ሉዓላዊነት እንደሚጋፋ በመግለጽ፣ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ይህንን ወረራ ለማስቆም የበኩሉን እንዲወጣ ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Turkiin Kolombiyaan naannoo Golan Heights irratti aangoo Israa'el beekamtii kennuushee balaaleffatteetti; naannichi kunis sadarkaa idil-addunyaatti kan biyyattii Sooriyaa akka ta'e beekama. Murtii kanaan dura biyyoonni akka Saudii Arabiyaa, Qatar fi Iraaq balaaleffannaa walfakkaatu dhageessisanii turan. Mootummaan Turkii tarkaanfichi kun abbaa biyyummaa Sooriyaa kan miidhu ta'uu ibsuun, hawaasni idil-addunyaa qabiyyee kana xumursiisuuf qooda akka fudhatu gaafateera.

title: US rights groups sue Trump administration over ICC sanctions
english: Four prominent human rights organizations have filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration regarding sanctions imposed on the International Criminal Court. The groups argue that these measures hinder their legal and humanitarian work and violate their constitutional rights by punishing those who interact with the court. These sanctions were introduced following investigations into high-level Israeli officials, including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, regarding alleged war crimes in Gaza.
amharic: አራት ታዋቂ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች በዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ላይ በተጣለው ማዕቀብ ላይ በመቃወም የትራምፕ አስተዳደርን ከሰዋል። ድርጅቶቹ እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች ህጋዊ እና ሰብአዊ ስራዎቻቸውን እንደሚገድቡ እና ከፍርድ ቤቱ ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸውን ሰዎች በመቅጣት ህገ-መንግስታዊ መብታቸውን እንደሚጥሱ ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ማዕቀብ የተጣለው ፍርድ ቤቱ በእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በተለይም በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ላይ በጋዛ የተፈጸሙ ጦርነቶችን በመመርመሩ ምክንያት ነው።
oromo: Jaarmayoonni mirga namoomaa afur beekamoon, mootummaan Trump adaba mana murtiitti idil-addunyaa (ICC) irratti buuse mormuun himata bananiiru. Jaarmayoonni kun adabni kun hojii isaanii kan guutuufi mirga isaanii kan sarbu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Adabni kun kan dhufeyis ICCn qorannoo yakka waraanaa gaggeessuu isaa hordofee hoogganoota Israa'el irratti, keessattuu muummicha ministeeraa Beenyaamiin Neetanyaahuu irratti kan xiyyeeffatedha.

title: Israel launches fresh attack on Bint Jbeil, southern Lebanon
english: The Israeli military has conducted a significant airstrike on the village of Haddatha, located in southern Lebanon's Bint Jbeil district. This report comes from Lebanese state media, which has labeled the operation a massive bombing campaign. Officials are currently monitoring the situation as it develops.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ቢንት ጅቤይል ወረዳ በሚገኘው የሐዳታ መንደር ላይ ከፍተኛ የአየር ጥቃት መፈጸሙ ተዘግቧል። የሊባኖስ የመንግስት የዜና ወኪል ጥቃቱ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት የሚያደርስ መጠነ ሰፊ የቦምብ ድብደባ እንደሆነ አስታውቋል። ሁኔታው አሁን በመካሄድ ላይ ያለ በመሆኑ ተጨማሪ መረጃዎች እንደሚጠበቁ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa'el ganda Haddataa kan kutaa Bint Jbeil, kibba Libaanoositti argamu irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa kan raawwate ta'uu gabaasni miidiyaa mootummaa Libaanoos ni ibsa. Haleellaan kun kan bal'atee fi kan cimaa akka ta'e gabaafameera. Haalli kun amma iyyuu itti fufee waan jiruuf, odeeffannoon dabalataa fuulduratti kan eegamu ta'a.

title: Father and sons forced to manually clear rubble in Gaza
english: A father and his children in Gaza are attempting to clear the ruins of their demolished home using only primitive hand tools. This difficult situation is occurring because Israeli authorities have restricted access to heavy machinery, preventing the effective recovery of bodies stuck under debris. Rescue teams report that these ongoing blockades are significantly hindering their ability to conduct search and recovery operations.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚኖር አንድ አባትና ልጆቹ የፈረሰውን ቤታቸውን ፍርስራሽ በእጅ መሳሪያዎች ብቻ ለማፅዳት እየሞከሩ ነው። እስራኤል ከባድ ማሽነሪዎች ወደ አካባቢው እንዳይገቡ በመከልከሏ በፍርስራሹ ስር የቀሩ አስከሬኖችን ለማውጣት አዳጋች ሆኗል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች እንደሚሉት ይህ የእገዳ እርምጃ የፍለጋ እና የነፍስ አድን ስራውን በእጅጉ እያስተጓጎለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gaazaa keessatti abbaan tokko fi ijoolleen isaa mana isaanii diigame harka duwwaafi meeshaalee salphaa fayyadamuun qulqulleessuuf yaalaa jiru. Mootummaan Israa'el meeshaalee gurguddaa gara naannichaa akka hin seenne dhorguu isheetiin, reeffa diigama jalatti hafe baasuun rakkisaa ta'eera. Gareewwan lubbuu baraartoonni akka jedhanitti, dhorkaan kun hojii barbaachaafi lubbuu baraaruu irratti gufuu guddaa ta'ee jira.

title: Inside the Secret Service 'shell game' to hide US presidents in plain sight
english: The US Secret Service frequently employs deceptive tactics to protect the president by keeping their true location secret from potential threats. Strategies include using decoys in motorcades, flying multiple helicopters in groups, and even secretly moving the president to different aircraft while others remain on the original plane as a distraction. These methods serve as a 'shell game' designed to confuse anyone intending to cause harm to the leader.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የደህንነት አገልግሎት የሀገሪቱን ፕሬዝዳንት ለመጠበቅ ሲባል ትክክለኛ የጉዞ መስመራቸውንና መገኛቸውን ከጠላቶች ለመደበቅ የተለያዩ የማታለያ ስልቶችን ይጠቀማል። ከነዚህም መካከል በክብር ተሽከርካሪዎች ላይ አስመሳይ ተሽከርካሪዎችን መጠቀም፣ ሄሊኮፕተሮችን በቡድን ማብረር እና ፕሬዝዳንቱን በድብቅ ወደ ሌላ አውሮፕላን ማዛወር ይገኙበታል። እነዚህ በዋናነት የአጥቂዎችን ትኩረት ለመሳብና ፕሬዝዳንቱን ከአደጋ ለመከላከል የሚከናወኑ ስልቶች ናቸው።
oromo: tajaajilli nageenyaa Ameerikaa (US Secret Service) prezidaanticha eeguuf jecha, bakka inni jiru dhoksuun mala garaagaraa fayyadama. Mala kanneen keessaa, konkolaattota nama wallaalchisan fayyadamuu, helikoptaroota gareen balaliisuu fi prezidaanticha dhoksaan xiyyaara biraatti jijjiiruu ni argamu. Mala kanneen 'shell game' jedhaman kun, kanneen prezidaantichatti miidhaa geessisuu barbaadan wallaalchisuufi nageenya isaa mirkaneessuuf kan gargaaran dha.

title: Relatives mourn victims of Pakistan avalanche
english: Grieving families have gathered at the airport in Kathmandu to receive the bodies of three Nepali mountain climbers. The mountaineers tragically lost their lives after being caught in a fatal avalanche on Broad Peak in Pakistan. Their remains were transported home for final funeral arrangements following the devastating accident.
amharic: በፓኪስታን ብሮድ ፒክ ተራራ ላይ በደረሰ የበረዶ ናዳ ህይወታቸውን ያጡ ሶስት የኔፓል ተራራ ወጣቾች አስክሬን ካትማንዱ በሚገኘው ትሪቡቫን አለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ደርሷል። የተጎጂዎቹ ቤተሰቦችና ወዳጅ ዘመዶች የአስክሬን መቀበያ ስነ-ስርዓት ላይ በመገኘት ጥልቅ ሀዘናቸውን ገልጸዋል። የሶስቱ ተራራ ወጣቾች አስክሬን ለቀብር ስነ-ስርዓታቸው ወደ ቤተሰቦቻቸው ተልኳል።
oromo: Maatiin fi firoonni namoota sadan biyya Nepal kan ta’an, erga gaara Broad Peak kan Paakistaan keessatti balaa cabbii (avalanche) mudateen booda du’an, reeffa isaanii simachuuf buufata xiyyaaraa Kathmandu walga’anii jiru. Namoonni sadan kunneen erga qophii gaarotaa irratti osoo jiranii balaa mudateen lubbuun isaanii darbee booda, qaamni isaanii gara biyyaatti deebi’eera. Maatiin isaanii fi hawaasni kun gadda guddaa keessa ta’uun, sirna awwaalchaa isaanii qopheeffachaa jiru.

title: Evening recap
english: Major regional developments include Saudi Arabia's refusal to include Egypt in a new defense pact, and reports of a potential agreement between the US and Iran. In violence, Houthi rebels are blamed for a deadly attack on a cargo ship near Yemen, while the US reported another maritime incident in the Gulf of Oman. Additionally, a Syrian court sentenced Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia, and Israel resumed formal diplomatic relations with Venezuela.
amharic: የዕለቱ ዋና ዋና ዜናዎች ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ግብፅን በአዲሱ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ውስጥ ለማካተት ፈቃደኛ አለመሆኗን እና አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ መቃረቧን ያካትታሉ። በሌላ በኩል በየመን አቅራቢያ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ሰዎች መገደላቸው እና በኦማን ባህረ ሰላጤ ሌላ የባህር ላይ ጥቃት መከሰቱ ተዘግቧል። በተጨማሪም የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞውን ፕሬዝዳንት በሽር አል-አሳድን በሞት የቀጣ ሲሆን እስራኤል እና ቬንዙዌላ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነታቸውን እንደገና መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Oduulee gurguddoo har'aa keessaa Sa’uudii Arabiyaan biyyi Gibxii walii galtee ittisaa haaraa keessatti akka hin hirmaanne mormuun ishee fi Ameerikaan Iiraan waliin walii galtee irra ga'uuf qophii ta'uun isaanii ibsameera. Gama biraatiin, qarqara galaana Yamanitti loltoota Huutii irraan miidhaa ga'een lubbuun namootaa darbuu fi galaana Omaan keessatti haleellaan biraa raawwatamuu gabaafameera. Kana malees, mana murtii Siiriyaatiin Bashar Al-Asaad irratti adabbiin du'aa murtaa'ee, akkasumas Israa'el fi Veenzuweelaan hariiroo diippiloomaasii isaanii haaromsuu isaanii beekameera.

title: Israel and Venezuela restore diplomatic relations after years of severed ties
english: Israel and Venezuela have officially resumed diplomatic relations after a 17-year break. This shift follows a change in leadership in Venezuela after the removal of former President Nicolas Maduro, leading to closer ties with the U.S. Both nations will now coordinate to provide consular services to their respective citizens.
amharic: እስራኤል እና ቬንዙዌላ ለ17 ዓመታት ተቋርጦ የቆየውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነታቸውን በይፋ እንደገና መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ለውጥ የመጣው በቬንዙዌላ የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንት ኒኮላስ ማዱሮ ከስልጣን መነሳት እና አዲሱ አመራር ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት በማጠናከሩ ነው። ሁለቱ ሀገራት ለዜጎቻቸው የቆንስላ አገልግሎት ለመስጠት የሚያስችል የጋራ ስምምነት አድርገዋል።
oromo: Israa'el fi Venzuweelaan waggoota 17 booda hariiroo diippiloomaasii isaanii irra deebi'anii akka jalqaban beeksisaniiru. Jijjiirramni kun kan dhufe pirezidaantii duraanii Nikoolaas Maaduuroon aangoo irraa erga bu'anii fi mootummaan Venzuweelaa kan amma jiru hariiroo isaa Ameerikaa waliin erga cimsee boodadha. Biyyonni lamaanuu amma tajaajila konsulaa lammiilee isaaniitiif kennuuf waliigaltee taasisaniiru.

title: US says helicopter fired missiles to disable ship breaking Iran blockade
english: The US military used helicopter-fired missiles to disable a Panama-flagged cargo ship that was attempting to breach the blockade of Iranian ports. American forces took this action after the crew refused to comply with multiple warnings to stop the vessel. This incident is part of ongoing efforts by the US to maintain a naval blockade amidst heightened regional tensions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች የኢራን ወደቦችን ለማገድ የተጣለውን እገዳ በመጣስ ወደ ኢራን ለመጓዝ የሞከረ የፓናማ ጭነት መርከብን በሄሊኮፕተር በተተኮሰ ሚሳኤል አቅም አሳጥተዋል። የአሜሪካ ኃይሎች ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰዱት የመርከቧ ሠራተኞች በተደጋጋሚ የተሰጣቸውን ማስጠንቀቂያ ባለማክበራቸው ነው። ይህ ክስተት በአካባቢው እየጨመረ ባለው ውጥረት መካከል አሜሪካ የኢራንን ወደቦች ለመቆጣጠር ከምታደርገው ጥረት አንዱ አካል ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa doonii fe'umsaa kan faandaamattii galmoofte, kan gabaa Iran cabsitee darbuuf yaaltu, xiyyaara haylikoppitaraatiin rukutuun akka hin deemne taasiseera. Humnoonni Ameerikaa tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatan hojjettoonni doonitii ajajaafi akeekkachiisa irra deddeebiin kennameef fudhachuu diduun isaaniitiin. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa keessatti Ameerikaan adeemsa dooniiwwan Iran to'achuuf qabdu keessaa tokko dha.

title: Pakistan interior minister in Tehran amid talks to reopen Hormuz
english: Pakistan's interior minister, Mohsin Naqvi, recently traveled to Tehran to meet with Iran's foreign minister. The visit is part of ongoing diplomatic efforts to resolve the conflict involving Iran and to restore shipping operations through the Strait of Hormuz. These discussions aim to address regional stability during the current period of heightened tension.
amharic: የፓኪስታን የውስጥ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሞህሲን ናቅቪ ከኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ጋር ለመወያየት በቴህራን ተገኝተዋል። የዚህ ጉብኝት ዋና ዓላማ በኢራን ዙሪያ ያለውን ግጭት ለመፍታት እና የሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን እንደገና ለመክፈት የሚደረገውን የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረት አካል ነው። ውይይቱ በአካባቢው ያለውን ውጥረት በማርገብ ሰላምን ለማስፈን ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma keessaa Paakistaan Mohsin Naqvi, mariiwwan dhimmoota nageenyaa fi diippiloomaasii irratti hirmaachuuf magaalaa Teheranitti argamu. Hojiin kun kan xiyyeeffatu waldhabdee biyyattii fi naannicha keessatti uumame furuuf akkasumas karaa bishaan Hormuz deebisanii banuufi. Mariin kun tasgabbii naannichaaf gumaacha gochuuf karoorfamee kan gaggeeffame dha.

title: In Gaza’s tents, widows face war’s harshest realities alone
english: Thousands of women in Gaza have been widowed by the ongoing conflict, leaving them to raise their children alone in precarious tent settlements. These women face extreme daily hardships, struggling to find basic necessities like food and water while dealing with the trauma of losing their spouses. With the number of widows now exceeding 50,000, these mothers are forced to manage the crushing weight of survival in a war zone without any support system.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት ሳቢያ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሴቶች ባሎቻቸውን በማጣታቸው፣ ልጆቻቸውን በድንኳን ውስጥ ብቻቸውን ለማሳደግ ተገደዋል። እነዚህ እናቶች በየቀኑ ምግብ እና ውሃን ለማግኘት ከፍተኛ ፈተና ከመጋፈጣቸውም በላይ፣ የትዳር አጋሮቻቸውን በማጣታቸው የሚመጣውን ስነ-ልቦናዊ ጫና ይቋቋማሉ። በአሁኑ ወቅት የባሎቻቸው ህልፈት የተረጋገጠባቸው ሴቶች ቁጥር ከ50,000 በላይ የደረሰ ሲሆን፣ እነዚህ እናቶች ምንም አይነት ድጋፍ ሳይኖራቸው በጦርነት ቀጠና ውስጥ ህልውናቸውን ለማስቀጠል እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gaza keessatti waraana amma adeemaa jiruun dubartoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman abbootii manaa isaanii dhabuun, ijoollee isaanii iddoo buufata dunkaanaa keessatti kophaa guddisuuf dirqamaniiru. Dubartoonni kun nyaataafi bishaan akka argataniif guyyuu rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru; kana malees hiriyoota gaa'elaa isaanii dhabuun gadda guddaa keessa jiraatu. Lakkoofsi dubartoota abbootii manaa dhabanii kun gara 50,000 ol kan gahe yommuu ta'u, haadhonni kun deeggarsa tokko malee waraana keessatti lubbuun jiraachuuf qabsoo cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: Fishermen face deadly dangers as Yemen’s Red Sea becomes a warzone
english: Yemeni fishermen in the Red Sea are facing life-threatening conditions due to ongoing regional conflict and military instability. Many individuals have been forced to stop working or risk their lives daily because the sea has transformed into a dangerous combat zone. Despite the severe economic decline in the fishing industry and the constant threat of violence, many families are compelled to continue these risky journeys to survive.
amharic: በቀይ ባህር ዳርቻ የሚኖሩ የየመን አሳ አጥማጆች በክልሉ ባለው ግጭትና የጦርነት ሁኔታ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የሕይወት አደጋ ተጋርጦባቸዋል። ባህሩ ወደ ጦርነት ቀጠናነት በመለወጡ ምክንያት ብዙዎች ሥራቸውን ለማቆም ተገደዋል። የዓሣ ማጥመጃው ዘርፍ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ውድቀት ቢገጥመውም፣ ብዙ ቤተሰቦች ለመኖር ሲሉ አሁንም አደጋውን ተጋፍጠው ወደ ባሕሩ ለመውጣት ይገደዳሉ።
oromo: Qulqulleeyyonni qurxummii Yemen, naannoo Galaana Diimaatti walitti bu'iinsa uumamee jiruun lubbuun isaanii waggaa hedduudhaaf balaa keessa bu'ee jira. Galaanichi gara iddoo waraanaatti waan jijjiirameef, namoonni baay'een hojii isaanii dhiisuuf ykn jireenya isaanii balaa keessa galchuuf dirqamaniiru. Indastiriin qurxummii xiqqachuu fi soda waraanaa cimaa keessa iyyuu, maatiin baay'een jiraachuuf jecha qorannoo kana akkasumas balaa jiru obsaan fudhatanii hojii isaanii itti fufaa jiru.

title: Israel demolishes home of Palestinian killed during settler attack
english: Israeli forces recently destroyed the family home of Farouk Ramadan, a Palestinian man who was killed in the occupied West Bank this past July. Ramadan lost his life while standing up against a significant attack carried out by Israeli settlers in the village of Tal. The demolition of the residence has been documented in video footage that captured the destruction of the property.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች ባለፈው ሐምሌ ወር በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ በታል መንደር በተፈጠረ ግጭት ወቅት የተገደለውን የፍልስጤማዊውን የፋሩቅ ረመዳንን መኖሪያ ቤት አፍርሰዋል። ረመዳን ሕይወቱ ያለፈው በአካባቢው በነበሩ ሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ወቅት በመከላከል ላይ ሳለ ነው። የቤቱ መፍረስ ክስተት በቪዲዮ መረጃ የተደገፈ ሲሆን፣ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች የመኖሪያ ቤቱን እንዳወደሙት የሚያሳይ ምስል ተለቋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el ganda Taal jedhamu keessatti baatii Adooleessa darbe haleellaa seenattoota Israa'elittin wal qabatee kan ajjeefame lammii Falasxiin Faaruuq Ramadaan manasaa diiganiiru. Ramadaan lubbuun kan darbe yeroo haleellaa seenattoota sana of irraa ittisuuf yaalaa turetti dha. Diigamuun mana kanaas viidiyoo gara garaatiin kan mirkanaa'e yoo ta'u, humnoonni Israa'el mana sana akka diigan gabaasichi ibseera.

title: DR Congo Ebola death toll surpasses 2,000
english: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has worsened significantly, with the number of fatalities now exceeding 2,000. Health authorities have confirmed that the total number of infections has climbed to more than 4,300 cases. This rapid spread of the virus continues to be a major public health concern for the region.
amharic: በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የተከሰተው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመዛመቱ የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ2,000 አልፏል። የጤና ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት በተረጋገጡ የኢንፌክሽን ጉዳዮች ቁጥር ከ4,300 በላይ ደርሷል። ይህ የቫይረሱ ፈጣን ስርጭት በክልሉ ላይ ከፍተኛ የጤና ስጋት መፍጠሩን ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Dhibee vaayirasii Ebola biyya Koongoo keessatti babal'achaa jiruun namoonni du'an lakkoofsaan 2,000 ol ga'aniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa fayyaa akka ibsanitti, namoonni dhibee kanaan qabaman 4,300 caalu. Babal'inni saffisaa vaayirasichaa kun naannichatti yaaddoo fayyaa cimaa uumaa jira.

title: US rights groups sue Trump administration over ICC sanctions
english: Four prominent human rights organizations have filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration, arguing that sanctions imposed on the International Criminal Court (ICC) are unconstitutional and illegal. The groups claim these measures restrict their ability to carry out vital legal and advocacy work by threatening anyone who interacts with the court. These sanctions were established following ICC investigations into senior Israeli officials regarding alleged war crimes in Gaza.
amharic: አራት ታዋቂ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች በዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት (ICC) ላይ የተጣለውን ማዕቀብ በመቃወም በዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ላይ ክስ መስርተዋል። ድርጅቶቹ ማዕቀቡ ሕገ-መንግስታዊ መብታቸውን የሚጥስ እና ከፍርድ ቤቱ ጋር የሚሰሩ ሰዎችን የሚያስፈራራ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ማዕቀብ የገዛው የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በጋዛ የፈጸሙት ተብሎ በሚጠረጠረው የጦር ወንጀል ምርመራ ምክንያት የተወሰደ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa afur beekamoon, mootummaan Trump Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa (ICC) irratti kutee fudhate seeraan alaa fi heera biyyattii kan cabsu akka ta'e himachuun himata bananiiru. Dhaabbileen kun akka jedhanitti, tarkanfiin kun namoota mana murticha waliin hojjetan hunda sodaachisuun hojii mirga namoomaa fi seeraa irratti gufuu ta'eera. Kutee kun kan godhame, ICCn qondaaltoota Israa'el irratti qorannoo yakka waraanaa Gizaatti raawwatamee jedhame irratti erga jalqabee booda dha.

title: Tucker Carlson says Israel pushed him to report false allegations against Hunter Biden
english: Conservative commentator Tucker Carlson recently claimed that associates of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pressured him to spread false allegations that Hunter Biden’s laptop contained evidence of child abuse. Carlson admitted that he received this misinformation from Israeli sources during the 2020 election period, despite the lack of any evidence to support such claims. He further suggested that the political climate in Washington discouraged criticizing Israel, leading many to incorrectly attribute the story to Russian propaganda instead.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ታዋቂ ተንታኝ ታከር ካርልሰን፣ የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የቅርብ ሰዎች፣ የጆ ባይደን ልጅ የሃንተር ባይደን ላፕቶፕ ህጻናትን የመድፈር ማስረጃ እንደያዘ አድርጎ እንዲያሰራጭ ግፊት ማድረጋቸውን ተናግረዋል። ካርልሰን በ2020 ምርጫ ወቅት ይህንን የሐሰት መረጃ ከእስራኤል ወኪሎች እንደደረሰው የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ምንም አይነት ማስረጃ ባይኖርም መረጃውን እንዲያሰራጭ መገፋፋቱን አስታውቀዋል። በወቅቱ የነበረው የዋሽንግተን የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ እስራኤልን መተቸትን አስቸጋሪ ስላደረገው፣ ብዙዎች ይህንን የተሳሳተ መረጃ ከሩሲያ የመጣ የፕሮፓጋንዳ ዘመቻ አድርገው መውሰዳቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Qeequn beekamaan Ameerikaa Taakar Kaarlsan, namoonni muummee ministira Israa'el Benyaamin Neetaanyaahuu walitti dhihoo jiran, laaptooppiin Haantar Baayiden ragaa miidhaa daa'immanii of keessaa qaba jedhee soba akka gabaasu dhiibbaa irratti godhaniiru jedhe. Kaarlsan odeeffannoo sobaa kana bara 2020 yeroo filannoo namoota Israa'el irraa akka fudhate kan ibse yoo ta'u, ragaan qabatamaan tokko iyyuu akka hin jirre mirkaneesseera. Haala siyaasaa Waashingitan keessa tureef jecha Israa'el komachuun waan ulfaateef, namoonni baay'een odeeffannoo dogoggoraa kana akka soba Raashiyaa biraa dhufeetti fudhachuuf dirqamuun isaanii ibsameera.

title: Truck crash in Egypt kills 18, many of them child labourers
english: A tragic truck accident in Egypt's Ismailia governorate has resulted in the deaths of at least 18 agricultural workers, many of whom were children aged 13 and 14. The crash occurred while the laborers were being transported to a farm, leaving dozens of others injured. Authorities have launched an investigation into the incident and promised financial support to the affected families.
amharic: በግብፅ እስማኢሊያ ግዛት ውስጥ በተከሰተ የጭነት መኪና አደጋ ቢያንስ 18 የግብርና ሰራተኞች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አደጋው የደረሰው ሰራተኞቹን ወደ እርሻ ቦታ ሲያጓጉዝ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል አብዛኛዎቹ የ13 እና 14 ዓመት ህጻናት መሆናቸው ተነግሯል። መንግስት በአደጋው ላይ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ያዘዘ ሲሆን ለተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እንደሚደረግ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Ityoophiyaa keessatti balaan konkolaataa mudateen hojjettoota qonnaa 18 du’aniiru, isaan keessaa baay’een isaanii ijoollee umurii 13 fi 14 kan ta’an dha. Balaan kun kan mudate yeroo hojjettoonni kun gara qonnaatti imalaa turanitti yoo ta’u, namoonni hedduunis miidhamaniiru. Mootummaan balaa kana irratti qorannoo akka godhu kan ajaje yoo ta’u, maatii miidhamtootaaf deeggarsa maallaqaa akka godhu waadaa galeera.

title: US claims responsibility for attack on neutral civilian ship
english: The U.S. military recently attacked a Panama-registered cargo ship in the Gulf of Oman for attempting to deliver goods to Iran. American forces disabled the vessel using a helicopter-fired missile strike after the crew refused to stop, claiming the ship violated a U.S. blockade. Officials stated this is one of many similar interventions conducted to enforce trade restrictions against Iran.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች በኦማን ባህረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ ወደ ኢራን በመጓዝ ላይ የነበረውን የፓናማ ጭነት መርከብ ጥቃት ሰንዝረው አቆሙት። መርከቧ የአሜሪካን የንግድ እገዳ ጥሳለች በሚል ሰበብ፣ የባህር ኃይል ሄሊኮፕተር ሚሳይሎችን በመተኮስ የመርከቧን ሞተር አበላሽቷል። አሜሪካ ይህ ድርጊት በኢራን ላይ የጣለችውን እገዳ ለማስፈጸም የምታደርገው ተደጋጋሚ እርምጃ አካል መሆኑን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Humnooni waraana Ameerikaa doonii fe’umsaa kan Paanaamaa kan gara Iraan imalaa turte tokko Ghanda Omaan keessatti haleelanii dhaabsisaniiru. Dooniin kun daldala Iraan irratti Ameerikaan kaa’e cabsiteetti jechuun, xiyyaarri helikoptaraa Ameerikaa miisaayiliin rukutee injinii dooniichaa miidheera. Ameerikaan gochi kun daldala Iraan irratti kaa’ame kabajchiisuuf tarkaanfii fudhatamu keessaa tokko ta’uu ibsiteetti.

title: Rescuers scramble for survivors with 180 dead in Colombia earthquake
english: A massive 7.4 magnitude earthquake has struck western Colombia, resulting in at least 180 deaths and thousands of injuries. Rescue teams are working urgently to locate nearly 200 missing people trapped under collapsed buildings, particularly in the cities of Cali and Pereira. The government has declared a state of emergency as thousands of residents face homelessness due to widespread structural damage.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በተከሰተ ኃይለኛ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 180 ሰዎች ሲሞቱ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቆስለዋል። በካሊ እና በፔሬራ ከተሞች የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በፍርስራሽ ስር የተጠመዱ ከ200 የሚበልጡ ሰዎችን ለማግኘት ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። መንግስት የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ ያወጀ ሲሆን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶች በመውደማቸው ነዋሪዎች መፈናቀላቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa dhihaatti birmadummaa 7.4 kan qabu sochiin lafaa cimaan erga uumamee booda, namoonni 180 ol du'anii kumaatamaan kan lakkaa'aman ammoo miidhamaniiru. Magaalota Kaalii fi Pereeraa keessatti gargaartonni namoota mana jigaa jala turan 200 ol ta'an baasuuf tattaaffii cimaa gochaa jiru. Mootummaan labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa kan labse yoo ta'u, manneen kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman waan jiganiif namoonni hedduu manaa fi qabeenyaa malee hafaniiru.

title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
english: The Lebanese parliament has officially voted to remove the death penalty, becoming the first country in the Middle East to take this step. Under the new law, capital punishment will be replaced by life imprisonment with hard labor for those currently on death row. While the bill still requires a final signature from the president, it marks a significant victory for human rights activists who have campaigned for years to end state-sanctioned executions.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ፓርላማ የሞት ቅጣትን በይፋ ለመሰረዝ ድምጽ ሰጥቷል፤ ይህ ውሳኔ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደ የመጀመሪያው ሀገር ያደርገዋል። በአዲሱ ህግ መሰረት የሞት ቅጣት በቀድሞ የሞት ቅጣት ተጠባባቂዎች ላይ በዕድሜ ልክ እስራት እና በግዴታ ስራ ይተካል፡፡ ህጉ በፕሬዝዳንቱ የመጨረሻ ፊርማ እስኪያገኝ ድረስ የሚጠበቅ ቢሆንም፣ ይህ ለዓመታት የሞት ቅጣት እንዲሰረዝ ሲታገሉ ለነበሩ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ትልቅ ድል ተደርጎ ተቆጥሯል።
oromo: Mana maree Libanon adabbii du'aa seera keessaa balleessuuf sagalee kennuun, biyya jalqabaa giddu gala bahaa taatee jirti. Seera haaraa kanaan, namoonni yeroo ammaa adabbii du'aatiif murteeffaman gara hidhaa umurii guutuu fi hojii humnaa cimaatti jijjiiramu. Seerichi mallattoo prezidaantiitiin mirkanaa'uun kan isa hafe ta'us, kun injifannoo guddaa gochuun mirga namoomaa waggoota dheeraaf adabbii kana dhaabsisuuf falmanii turaniiti.

title: UNESCO says 2.4 million Afghan girls denied access to further education
english: UNESCO reports that approximately 2.4 million Afghan girls are currently unable to attend secondary school due to Taliban policies. The organization warns that this number could rise to four million by 2030 if current restrictions remain unchanged. Afghanistan is now the only nation globally that prohibits girls and women from accessing higher levels of education.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የትምህርት፣ የሳይንስ እና የባህል ድርጅት (ዩኔስኮ) በታሊባን መንግስት በተጣለ እገዳ ምክንያት ወደ 2.4 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ የአፍጋኒስታን ሴት ተማሪዎች ከሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት ውጪ መሆናቸውን አስታውቋል። አሁን ያለው የትምህርት እገዳ ካልተቀየረ በፈረንጆቹ 2030 የዚህ ቁጥር ወደ አራት ሚሊዮን ሊያድግ እንደሚችል ድርጅቱ በስጋት ገልጿል። አፍጋኒስታን ሴቶች ከሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት እና ከዩኒቨርሲቲ ትምህርት እንዲታገዱ ያደረገች ብቸኛ የዓለማችን ሀገር ሆና ቀጥላለች።
oromo: Dhaabbanni UNESCO akka ibsetti, namootni miliyoona 2.4 ta'an kan ta'an shamarran Afgaanistaan seera mootummaa Taalibaan irraa kan ka'e mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaa akka hin hordofne dhorkamaniiru. Akkaataa ammaa kanaan itti fufuun, lakkoofsi kun hanga bara 2030tti gara miliyoona afuriitti ol guddachuu akka danda'u dhaabbatichi akeekkachiiseera. Afgaanistaan biyya addunyaa kanaa keessatti shamarranifi dubartoota barnoota sadarkaa olaanaa irraa dhorkite ishee qofa dha.

title: Venezuela and Israel restore consular ties as relations warm
english: Venezuela and Israel have decided to restore consular relations, marking a significant diplomatic shift after seventeen years of severed ties. This move follows the recent leadership change in Venezuela and a collaborative humanitarian effort to assist the country after devastating earthquakes. While not a full restoration of diplomatic relations, this agreement aims to provide essential services to citizens and improve coordination between the two nations.
amharic: ቬኔዙኤላ እና እስራኤል ለ17 ዓመታት ተቋርጦ የነበረውን የቆንስላ ግንኙነታቸውን እንደገና ለመጀመር ተስማምተዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተደረሰው በቬኔዙኤላ የአመራር ለውጥ ከተደረገ በኋላ እና ሁለቱ ሀገራት በሀገሪቱ የደረሰውን የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ተከትሎ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ትብብር ካደረጉ በኋላ ነው። ምንም እንኳን ሙሉ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ባይሆንም፣ ስምምነቱ ለዜጎች አስፈላጊ የሆኑ አገልግሎቶችን ለመስጠት እና በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ቅንጅት ለማሻሻል ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Venezuweelaan fi Israa'el hariiroo qonsilaa waggaa 17 dura adda cite ture deebisanii jalqabuuf walii galaniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufe erga biyyattii keessatti jijjiiramni hogganaa mudatee fi yeroodhaaf lafti erga socho'ee booda hojiin gargaarsa namoomaa waliinii erga raawwatamee booda. Kun hariiroo dippiloomaasii guutuu kan hin taane ta'us, waliigalteen kun tajaajila barbaachisaa ta'e lammiilee biyyoota lamaanii biraan gahuufi walitti dhufeenya isaanii fooyyessuuf kan gargaaru dha.

title: Tightened blockade on Gaza causes prices to soar
english: Israel has intensified its blockade on Gaza, severely restricting the supply of essential goods entering the territory. This move has triggered a dramatic rise in prices for basic items. Consequently, residents are struggling to survive by relying on minimal resources like fans and lighters for their daily energy needs.
amharic: እስራኤል በጋዛ ላይ የጣለችውን ማዕቀብ በማጥበቋ ወደ ክልሉ የሚገቡ አስፈላጊ ሸቀጦች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሰዋል። ይህም መሰረታዊ የሆኑ ምርቶች ዋጋ እንዲንር አድርጓል። በዚህም የተነሳ የጋዛ ነዋሪዎች የዕለት ተዕለት የሃይል ፍላጎታቸውን ለማሟላት እንደ ማቀዝቀዣ እና ላይተር ባሉ ጥቂት ቁሳቁሶች ላይ ለመመካት ተገደዋል።
oromo: Israa'el daangaa Gaazaa irratti jirtu cimsitee waan jirtuuf, gabaa keessatti meeshaaleen barbaachisoon akka hin galle ta'aniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun gatiin meeshaalee bu'uuraa akka ol ka'u taasiseera. Haala kanaan, jiraattonni magaalaa sanaa fedhii humnaa guuttachuuf meeshaalee salphaa akka fanifi ifa kennitootatti fayyadamuun jiraachaa jiru.

title: Paramount CEO may remove operations from California over stalled merger
english: Paramount CEO David Ellison is threatening to move the company's operations out of California if state officials do not drop their opposition to his merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. A coalition of state attorneys general is currently trying to block the deal, citing concerns over reduced competition and higher prices for consumers. If a settlement is not reached by October, Ellison may relocate the business to states like Texas, Tennessee, or Georgia.
amharic: የፓራማውንት ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ዴቪድ ኤሊሰን ከዋርነር ብሮስ ጋር ሊያደርጉት የታቀደው ውህደት ካልተፈቀደ ኩባንያውን ከካሊፎርኒያ እንደሚያስወጡ አስፈራሩ። የበርካታ ግዛቶች አቃቤ ህጎች ይህ ውህደት የገበያ ተወዳዳሪነትን ይቀንሳል በሚል ክስ መስርተውበት ይገኛል። ኤሊሰን በኦክቶበር ወር ውስጥ ስምምነት ካልተደረሰ ኩባንያውን ወደ ሌሎች ግዛቶች እንደሚያዘዋውሩ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan olaanaan dhaabbata Paramount, David Ellison, walitti makamuun isaanii kan Warner Bros. Discovery waliin ta'e yoo hin hayyamamne hojii dhaabbatichaa California keessaa akka baasu akeekkachiiseera. Abbootii alangaa biyyattii keessa jiran gariin, walitti makamuun kun dorgommii gabaa akka hir'isuu fi gatii akka dabalu sodaachun mormaa jiru. Ellison hanga ji'a Onkoloolessaatti walii galteen yoo hin uumamne, dhaabbaticha gara naannoowwan biroo kan akka Texas, Tennessee ykn Georgia tti akka jijjiiru beeksiseera.

title: ‘Justice at last’: Syrians react to Assad death sentence
english: A Syrian court has issued death sentences in absentia against former president Bashar al-Assad and security official Atef Najib. Many Syrian citizens gathered at the Justice Palace in Damascus to celebrate the ruling, viewing it as a significant milestone for accountability. This decision is being widely regarded as a crucial initial move toward achieving transitional justice for the country.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞውን ፕሬዝዳንት ባሻር አል አሳድን እና የደህንነት ባለስልጣኑን አተፍ ናጂብን በሌሉበት የሞት ቅጣት ፈርዶባቸዋል። በርካታ የሶሪያ ዜጎች በደማስቆ በሚገኘው የፍትህ ቤተ መንግስት ፊት ለፊት ተሰብስበው ይህንን ውሳኔ በደስታ ተቀብለውታል። ውሳኔው ለአገሪቱ የሽግግር ፍትህ ለማምጣት ወሳኝ የመጀመሪያ እርምጃ ተደርጎ ተወስዷል።
oromo: Mana murtii Sooriyaa kan duraanii, pirezidaantii Baashaar Al-Asaad fi qondaala nageenyaa Ateef Naajib irratti adabbii du'aa murteesseera. Lammiileen Sooriyaa hedduun mana murtii Damaasqoo duratti walga'uun murtee kana gammachuun simataniiru. Murteen kun biyyattiif jijjiiramaa fi haqaa fiduuf tarkaanfii jalqabaa murteessaa akka ta'e dubbatamaa jira.

title: Houthis say they attacked Saudi ship in Bab el-Mandeb
english: Yemeni Houthi rebels have claimed responsibility for an attack on a Saudi vessel located in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. According to reports from the group's news agency, the targeted ship was transporting military supplies. Further details regarding the incident are currently limited as the situation continues to unfold.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲ አማፂያን በባብ አል-ማንደብ የባህር ወሽመጥ ውስጥ የሳውዲ አረቢያ መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት ማድረሳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የቡድኑ መገናኛ ብዙኃን እንደዘገቡት፣ ጥቃት የደረሰባት መርከብ ወታደራዊ መሳሪያዎችን ጭና ትጓዝ ነበር። ስለ ጉዳዩ ተጨማሪ መረጃዎች እስካሁን በግልፅ አልታወቁም፣ ክስተቱ እየተጣራ ነው።
oromo: Humni fincilaa Huutii kan Yemen, doonii Saudii tokko kan daandii galaana Baab al-Mandab keessa jirtu irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Gabaasni dhaabbata oduu garee kanaa akka ibsetti, dooniin haleelame kun meeshaalee waraanaa fe'ee kan ture dha. Haata'u malee, waa'ee haleellaa kanaa odeeffannoon dabalataa ammas kan hin argamne yoo ta'u, dhimmi kun hordofamaa jira.

title: Exclusive: Saudi Arabia opposed Egypt's inclusion in Mecca agreement, sources say
english: Saudi Arabia recently blocked Egypt from joining a new joint defense pact signed with Turkey and Pakistan. While Turkey advocated for Cairo's inclusion, Riyadh resisted due to ongoing political frustrations and a perceived decline in Egypt's strategic value. This decision highlights cooling diplomatic relations, as Saudi Arabia feels Egypt has failed to provide sufficient support on critical security matters.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረብ ከቱርክ እና ከፓኪስታን ጋር በፈረመችው አዲስ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ግብፅ እንዳትካተት አግዳለች። ቱርክ ግብፅን ለማካተት ብትሞክርም፣ ሳዑዲ ዓረብ በወቅታዊ የፖለቲካ አለመግባባቶች እና በግብፅ ስትራቴጂያዊ ጠቀሜታ መቀነስ ምክንያት ይህንን ተቃውማለች። ይህ ውሳኔ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት እየቀዘቀዘ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Saudii Arabaan walii galtee ittisa biyyaalessaa kan haaraa Turkiifi Paakistaan waliin mallatteessite irratti, Gibxi akka hin hirmaanne dhorkiteetti. title: US jury in Luigi Mangione murder trial to remain anonymous
english: A New York judge has ruled that jurors in the murder trial of Luigi Mangione, who is accused of killing UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, will remain anonymous. This rare decision is intended to protect jurors from potential harassment due to the high-profile nature of the case, which centers on frustration over healthcare industry practices. The trial is scheduled to begin in September, with prosecutors planning to present significant evidence, including surveillance footage and items recovered from the defendant.

oromo: Abbaan seeraa Niiwu Yoorkii tokko, namoota shakkamaa ajjeechaa hojii gaggeessaa olaanaa Yuunaytid Heelth Keer (UnitedHealthcare) Biraayin Tompson irratti murtoo kennan, jechuunis maangiyooniif, maqaan isaanii akka hin beekamne murteessaniiru. title: Russia frees ex-US Marine Robert Gilman from detention
english: Russia has released former US Marine Robert Gilman after he spent four years in detention following a 2022 arrest. President Donald Trump confirmed his return and stated that his release was granted on humanitarian grounds without any prisoner swap. Although official reports suggest he is in stable condition, some lawmakers have expressed concern regarding his health and the alleged mistreatment he suffered while in custody.
